concept: CloudWatch alarms: alert on a metric threshold (CPUUtilization)
tests: Which service automatically alerts when average EC2 CPU stays above 80% for 5 minutes.
expected: Amazon CloudWatch alarm on the CPUUtilization metric (threshold 80%, period 5 min) → SNS notification or action. Triggers: "alerted automatically", "CPU utilization exceeds 80% for five minutes".
why_not: CloudTrail is API calls, not metrics; Config is configuration compliance; X-Ray is request tracing.
